name: Erolympics ~Sei no Saiten~
original_name: エロリンピック～性の祭典～
source:
I am a member of "Yarimakuru Doumei" (Going Wild and Having Fun) club. 
Today I'm participating in the Erolympics hosted by the club. 

The significance of the Erolympics isn't in participating, but in how many beautiful women you can arouse and lead to ecstasy.

If you do well, you'll get a gold medal. If you fail, you'll face some hardship... 

As a man, and as proof of being a sex king, I'm going to try to win the gold medal again today!

[Edited from Getchu]
